# Sleep Calculator

An advanced, human-centric web application and educational platform centered on sleep cycles, circadian rhythm alignment, and performance optimization. Built for students, shift workers, and anyone seeking to eliminate daytime fatigue.

## Main Tools

- [90-Minute Sleep Calculator](/sleep-cycle-calculator-90-minutes): Calculate optimal sleep durations using natural sleep cycles.
- [Ideal Bedtime Calculator](/ideal-bedtime-based-on-wake-up-time): Find the perfect time to fall asleep based on your wake-up alarm.
- [Wake Up Between Cycles](/wake-up-between-sleep-cycles): Real-time calculator for current sleep planning.
- [Student Sleep Calculator](/student-sleep-calculator): Academic performance sleep planner.
- [Shift Work Sleep Calculator](/shift-work-sleep-calculator): Circadian alignment planner for night shifts.

## Educational Resources

- [Sleep Guides & Research](/blog): Full collection of evidence-based sleep articles.
- [Scientific Foundations](/llm.txt): Deep dive into the math and sleep physiology used in our calculators.
